newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Jordanian Premier's plane in emergency landing.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian Premier's plane in emergency landing.

text.p: A Royal Jordanian airliner carrying 162 people including the Jordanian Prime Minister made an emergency landing at Ireland's Shannon airport on Sunday after developing mechanical problems, airport officials said.
They said one of the engines of the craft, which was on a flight from New York to the Jordanian capital, Amman, shut down, forcing an unscheduled emergency stop on Ireland's West Coast.
Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti was among the passengers, the officials said.
Ambulances and fire engines were deployed when the aircraft touched down but there were no incidents.
Airport officials said the plane was being examined to see if it could continue on its original route.
